[EN] It seems the {@LinkCreature:22#9#shadow instructors} are going to destroy the world. And they didn't invite me.

I want you to stop them. It's all well and good to plot, but exclude me and it stops being fun!
[ES] Parece que los {@LinkCreature:22#9#shadow instructors} van a destruir el mundo. Y no me invitaron.

Quiero que los detengas. Está muy bien conspirar, ¡pero exclúyeme y deja de ser divertido!

[EN] A witch rarely gives her word because we're loathe to break them. You've done a great service and I won't forget it.

I hope this madness ends soon. Do you know what I miss? Leeches...and peaches.
[ES] Una bruja rara vez da su palabra porque nos repugna romperla. Has hecho un gran servicio y no lo olvidaré.

Espero que esta locura termine pronto. ¿Sabes qué extraño? Sanguijuelas... y duraznos.
